meta.name: refseq33m
meta.index: refseq33m-experimental: RefSeq 97, k=31 basic (forward-only) DBGSuccinct, row_diff_brwt_coord, columns = record taxids, headers = record accessions
meta.limits_hint: staging: 4 seeds per request, 5 s per seed
built_from: refseq-exp/seeds/panel.json (the 2026-10-03/04 seed panel; labels verified there, at window offset 0)
refseq-exp/seeds/material, refseq-exp/traverse/material (NCBI efetch of NC_000913.3 / NC_002516.2 regions)
~/metagraph-indexes/uhgg/{g153.fna, MGYG000000041.fna} (contigs identical in length to their RefSeq records)
notes: every seed is a window of `source` at `offset`; --window-offset K moves it to offset+K (wrapped inside the source)

record_header is the source record: it carries every window of the source (kmer and trace), so the named and trace walks stay valid at any offset; headers/columns were verified at offset 0 only (used for /resolve, where a label that does not carry a k-mer is simply reported unsupported)
basic graph: windows are in the record's forward orientation
r16S_univ (heterogeneous, 28.9 s first-touch discover) is left out on purpose

gut_153.notes: single carrier (1 column / 1 record); UHGG genome MGYG-HGUT-00153 is itself a RefSeq WGS record

gut_41.notes: single carrier; the depth-0 lookahead case (#010: dcol r3000 t250 b1000 took 2.2 s first touch)

poxa48_repA.notes: repA of pOXA-48; 37 columns / 325 records carry the window; right arm reaches the record end after 5,040 bp

ndm1_amr.notes: blaNDM-1 [300,360); 82 columns / 900 records; named labels finish 1000 bp in ~1.3 s

pa_gyrB.notes: PAO1 gyrB; 155 full-length columns, ~2.4k headers per k-mer; named/trace reach 450-650 bp in 5 s

ec_rplJ.notes: E. coli rplJ; ~2.8k columns / ~15.6k headers per k-mer; named/trace reach 160-200 bp in 5 s

ec_23S_dV.notes: 23S domain V; ~8.2k columns / ~42k headers per k-mer; named/trace reach 25-42 bp in 5 s; the call-size seed of the analysis (1 vs 3 vs 30 k-mers)

fresh_23S_nt301.notes: W6 of the traversal phase (23S nt 301-360); #009: derived columns at 1 s took 7.4 s first touch (failed)

fresh_S10_rpsD.notes: W1 of the traversal phase (rpsD region, + strand); #004: named header at 1 s took 4.6 s first touch
